title: maskfilter
description:
Perform filtering operations on 3D / 4D mask images.

The available filters are: clean, connect, dilate, erode, median.

Each filter has its own unique set of optional parameters.

References:

scale.description: the maximum scale used to cut bridges. A certain maximum scale cuts bridges up to a width (in voxels) of 2x the provided scale. (Default: 2)
scale.title: scale

axes.description: specify which axes should be included in the connected components. By default only the first 3 axes are included. The axes should be provided as a comma-separated list of values.
axes.title: axes

largest.description: only retain the largest connected component
largest.title: largest

npass.description: the number of times to repeatedly apply the filter
npass.title: npass

extent.description: specify the extent (width) of kernel size in voxels. This can be specified either as a single value to be used for all axes, or as a comma-separated list of the extent for each axis. The default is 3x3x3.
extent.title: extent

strides.description: specify the strides of the output data in memory; either as a comma-separated list of (signed) integers, or as a template image from which the strides shall be extracted and used. The actual strides produced will depend on whether the output image format can support it.
strides.title: strides

quiet.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.
quiet.title: quiet

force.description: force overwrite of output files (caution: using the same file as input and output might cause unexpected behaviour).
force.title: force

nthreads.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
nthreads.title: nthreads

key.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
key.title: key

value.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
value.title: value

config.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
config.title: config

help.description: display this information page and exit.
help.title: help

filter.description: the type of filter to be applied (clean, connect, dilate, erode, median)
filter.title: filter
